g.text: Selection path fixed before cross-platform follow-up
Excluded before testing: SSU72 and TRAPPC1, both lacking direct observation of both carrier directions.
Five corrected discovery loci: CCND3, CUTA, PSMB8, RPL41 and SMAP2.
RPL41 and SMAP2 remain long-read observations; CCND3, CUTA and PSMB8 form the cross-platform panel.
Two-sided exact sign-flip test; 8,192 assignments; BH correction over nine loci
All points are donor-level effects from the 13-donor discovery long-read cohort; values are not pooled across donors.
